title.value: In-Processing fairness improvement methods for regression Data-Driven building Models: Achieving uniform energy prediction
title.justification: The title clearly reflects the main focus of the paper which is on improving fairness in data-driven building models particularly in the energy prediction context.
title.quote: Title of the paper: In-Processing fairness improvement methods for regression Data-Driven building Models: Achieving uniform energy prediction

extractions.description: The paper discusses methods to improve predictive fairness in data-driven regression models for building energy prediction. Four in-processing methods are introduced to ensure uniform energy prediction across different conditions. The study aims to balance fairness and accuracy in predictive performance, particularly in the context of varying occupancy in apartments.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The paper's focus on energy prediction and management in buildings is directly related to climate change themes as it deals with optimizing energy use, which is a crucial aspect of climate mitigation efforts.
climate_change_is_central.quote: energy prediction models could be integrated into model predictive controller to provide optimal control signals for building energy management systems to achieve energy saving, cost saving, and/or peak shifting
